en.quote: Increase the share of innovative products in total industrial output to 25–35 percent by 2020 (from 4.9 percent in 2010).
en.head: Innovative products accounted for 6.4% in 2020.
en.body: The government strategy aimed for innovative products to make up 25–35% of industrial output by 2020. HSE researchers, using Rosstat data, put innovative goods and services at 6.4% of industrial sales in 2020. This is a closely related indicator, although its stated denominator is not worded identically to the target.

osrc.t: Institute for Statistical Studies and Economics of Knowledge, HSE University
